inventory.limits: Source fit remains retail terminology, not observed geometry. Coarse fields are isolated from rejected wash assertions but remain unverified. Unknown is not absence; titles never establish photographed color. This inventory is not an approved training manifest.

review.reviewer: Codex qualitative visual inspection; not human attribute ground truth
review.scope: Coarse color, lightness and tone drafts only; no wash-label rehabilitation.

findings.color_family: Coarse blue/neutral split is visually plausible on this limited set, pending blind human calibration. No accuracy certified.
findings.lightness: Labels collapse to medium even for white, pale blue and dark navy examples. Do not scale lightness annotation.
findings.observed_tone: No agreed yellow-cast anchors or human reference labels; do not certify tone from this inspection.

decisions.lightness: hold; establish anchors and revise prompt/measurement
decisions.observed_tone: hold until yellow-cast definition and anchors

human_gate.selection: Targeted contrasting/borderline examples: white, dark blue, lighter blue, black, gray and a wearing crop. Not a random accuracy sample.

limits: Six selected examples calibrate anchors and expose failure cases; they do not estimate population accuracy or approve automatic labeling at scale. Machine screening and human review are distinct. Calibration assets are not a fresh test set.
